test_title: PYST 21: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 17 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

There was no one left in the world whom they could call ______.
solution:
The correct answer is '**theirs**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The pronoun "**theirs**" is a possessive pronoun, meaning something that belongs to them.
 
• The sentence is talking about someone they could call as their own, thus the possessive pronoun "**theirs**" is correct.
 
• **Options 1, 2,** and **3** are grammatically incorrect in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"There was no one left in the world whom they could call **theirs**__."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "there's"** is incorrect because it is a contraction of "there is".
 
• **Option 2: "their's"** is incorrect because there is no such grammatical contraction.
 
• **Option 3: "their"** is incorrect in this context; it is a possessive adjective and not a possessive pronoun.
